newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MOST PRICES UP, FOCUS ON BANKING STOCKS.
newsitem.headline: MOST PRICES UP, FOCUS ON BANKING STOCKS.

text.p: Buying pressure helped prices firm in morning trade on the Estonian bourse with strong interest in Hansapank and its bonus share issue, dealers said.
Share trade on the main list by 0815 GMT was 22.4 million kroons and the Talse index was 1.10 percent higher at 262.05.
Hansapank was the most active on trade of 10.9 million kroons to rise to 271.50/272.00 kroons versus 268.00 kroons.
"Hansapank saw strong buying interest in the morning, althought some analysts think the stock is overvalued," one trader said.
"The interest in Hansapank seems to be based on the belief that the bonus issue will not see the stocks's price fall by half, but will be less than that to give a good return to investors," he added.
Hansapank has said it will double its share capital with an issue of shares.
Hoiupank saw trade of 6.2 million kroons of shares to be moving upwards to a spread of 131.50/132.45.
The free market was slow with most attention focussed on the the main list. The free market registered trade of 0.8 million kroons of shares.
Norma was the most actice with on turnover of 0.6 million kroons of shares. It was stable at 74.64/74.95 versus a close of 74.83 kroons.
"The main list is in focus today and the free market is expected to stay quiet," another dealer said.
